verdict.rationale: Sill's own docs show a macOS host streaming to iPhone and iPad viewers, so host and viewer do run on different operating systems (macOS to iOS/iPadOS). Platform coverage stops at Apple's ecosystem: the host is Mac-only and the clients are iPhone/iPad only. missing for 10: Windows/Linux host or client, Android client, desktop viewer client, any non-Apple cross-OS pairing.

support.subject: As a power user, clients cover the desktop and mobile platforms I use, and host and viewer can run on different operating systems

citations.quote: Sill shows a window from your Mac, or its whole desktop, on your iPhone or iPad
Direct Wireless Connection lets an iPhone or iPad near your Mac connect without a shared Wi-Fi network
Each iPhone or iPad pairs with your Mac once.
